definitions.gloss: street parking; parking on the road
definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of {路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ} (parking on a public road). Often implies illegal or inconsiderate parking, though it can also refer to legitimate curbside parking.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{路駐|ろちゅう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧だ。
{路駐|ろちゅう}⟦していたら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}られた→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a parking ticket for parking on the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{路駐|ろちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通る：01243_tooru⟧にくい。
examples.english: This street is hard to get through because there are so many cars parked on it.

notes:
USAGE:
{路駐|ろちゅう} is an informal abbreviation of ⟦{路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ}→路上駐車：24063_rojouchuusha⟧ (on-street parking). It is commonly used in everyday conversation and often carries a negative nuance of illegal or nuisance parking.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a suru-verb: {路駐|ろちゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to park on the street).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路駐|ろちゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to park on the street)
- {路駐|ろちゅう}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no street parking)
- {路駐|ろちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧ (crackdown on illegal parking)
